opening_message:
Ticket 1: John Rodriguez (employee ID E049) requests write access to Source Code.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E049.
Note 1 (ticket 1):
  - role: Analyst
  - employment type: full_time
  - recommendation for Source Code: write
  - comment: John Rodriguez (E049) is a full-time Analyst. Requesting write access to Source Code. As a full-time employee, write is the maximum level for non-owners of the system; the request is at the maximum and is approved.
Note 2 (ticket 1):
  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - recommendation for Source Code: read
  - comment: Security DB shows John Rodriguez (E049) is a contractor with basic security training. Contractors max out at read without advanced training, and never admin. Recommended level: read.
reason: The two notes conflict on employment type: HR's note says full-time Analyst, while Security's note (from the Security DB) says contractor with basic security training. Per policy, contractors with basic training are limited to read (never admin, write only with advanced training). Since the requested write exceeds the maximum under the security facts, I grant the maximum allowed: read.
